title: Careers | EC Assets
description: Join EC Assets in Berlin. We are an international team building the simplest way to move to Germany, and we are hiring.

blocks.html: EC Assets is a growing company with short decision paths and real ownership from the first week. Most of us moved to Germany ourselves, which is why we care about getting this right.
We look for people who take initiative, ask good questions and enjoy working with colleagues from many countries.
Roles in engineering, customer support, partnerships and marketing open regularly. Have a look at what is currently available and apply online.
